newsitem.title: CANADA: Bombardier gets C$97.4 mln GO Transit deal.
newsitem.headline: Bombardier gets C$97.4 mln GO Transit deal.

text.p: GO Transit said on Friday that it awarded a six-year, C$97.4 million maintenance contract to Bombardier Inc.

The contract is to maintain and service GO's active fleet of 283 bi-level railcars and 40 locomotives, work that had been contracted to Canadian National Railway Co, which operates GO's trains on six of its seven lines.
The six-year agreement takes effect June 1, and on expiry of CN's present maintenance contract includes an option to renew for a further three years.
The GO Train network carries about 90,000 passengers every weekday between suburban areas of the Greater Toronto Area and downtown Toronto.
